title: mimulus glabratus var. jamesii
intro: Mimulus glabratus var. jamesii, commonly known as James' monkey flower, is a flowering plant species in the Phrymaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and soothing irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus glabratus var. jamesii include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, making it useful in treating anxiety and stress-related issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are thought to include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive properties.
